description: This PHP class 'MembershipModel' is part of the OrangeHRM human resource management system, specifically within the Admin API module. It serves as a model for representing membership data in the API layer, implementing serialization and normalization functionalities via traits and interfaces, and encapsulating a 'Membership' entity.

classes.name: MembershipModel
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class representing Membership details within the OrangeHRM API, supporting serialization and normalization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MembershipModel with a Membership entity and sets up filtering for 'id' and 'name'.
